Focus on how your unique skills will contribute to their specific goals, using details from the job posting and your resume to frame your inquiries. Your questions should reveal your strategic value, not just your curiosity. That moment at the end of an interview, when they turn the tables and ask, "Do you have any questions for us?" can feel like a pop quiz. Most anxious job seekers just want to get through it, but this is actually your final, best chance to show them you're the solution to their problems. I promise, you can turn this moment into a powerful demonstration of your value. When all three stack into one breath, people remember you. 01 How do I show I've already started thinking about their problems? Frame your questions around specific challenges or goals mentioned in the job posting or throughout the interview, demonstrating youâre already in problem-solving mode for them. This shifts you from interviewee to potential partner, showing youâre not just looking for a job, but for impact. Youâre not asking what they do; youâre asking how you can help them do it better. For example, if the posting mentions expanding into a new market, you might ask, "I noticed the posting highlighted a push into the APAC region. What specific metrics are you tracking for success in that expansion over the next 12 months, and how do you see this role directly contributing to those early wins?" This tells them you read the posting, you understand their strategic direction, and you're already thinking about measurable outcomes. It's a much stronger signal than, "What's the team culture like?" I want you to make every question a mini pitch for your specific skills. 02 Should I ask about the 30/60/90 day plan? Asking about the 30/60/90 day plan is a smart move, but only if you frame it to show how you'd execute your own plan, not just hear theirs. jobs.title: Senior Manager Accounting & Controlling (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle Im Mittelstand wird das Rechnungswesen in Teile zerlegt und weitergegeben: Einer bucht, einer baut den Abschluss, einer spricht mit dem Unternehmer. Am Ende kennt niemand das Unternehmen ganz — und der Inhaber bekommt Zahlen, mit denen er nicht steuern kann. Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Für diese Unternehmen übernehmen wir das Rechnungswesen vollständig: die laufende Verarbeitung mit hohem Automatisierungsgrad, die handelsrechtliche Bilanzierung und darauf aufbauend Auswertung, Planung und Controlling. Du verantwortest diese Strecke fachlich und baust sie aus. Du bist Wirtschaftsprüfer oder trägst seit Jahren die Verantwortung für handelsrechtliche Abschlüsse — in einer Prüfungs- oder Steuerberatungsgesellschaft oder im Rechnungswesen eines Mittelständlers. Du kennst den Punkt, an dem deine Arbeit endet: Der Abschluss ist fertig, das Testat liegt vor — und die eigentliche unternehmerische Frage wird danach entschieden, ohne dich. Bei Vogel findest du das Gegenteil: Strukturen, die tragen — etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis — und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht. Kein Prüfungszyklus, der bei jedem Mandat von vorn beginnt. Kein Konzern-Korsett. Du führst deine Mandate vollständig durch die Zahlen — vom laufenden Rechnungswesen über den Abschluss bis in das Gespräch, in dem der Unternehmer seine Entscheidungen trifft. Es gibt keine Schnittstelle, an der du übergibst. Du führst ein Team und berichtest an die Geschäftsführung. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt in eine Director-Rolle mit Verantwortung für Accounting und Controlling über mehrere Standorte. Deine Verantwortung Rechnungswesen und Bilanzierung Verantworte das laufende Rechnungswesen deiner Mandate unter hohem Automatisierungsgrad — und treib diesen Grad weiter, statt Handarbeit zu verwalten. Dein Maßstab ist nicht, dass die Zahlen am Ende stimmen, sondern wie wenig manueller Aufwand dafür nötig war. Verantworte den handelsrechtlichen Jahresabschluss inklusive Anhang und Bericht — als eigenständiges Ergebnis für den Unternehmer, nicht als Vorstufe der Steuererklärung. Du bereitest den handelsrechtlichen Teil vor, unsere Steuerberatung verantwortet den steuerlichen Teil und die Deklaration. Definiere, wann ein Abschluss abschlussfähig ist, und mach daraus einen Standard, der auch unter Fristendruck trägt — inklusive Vier-Augen innerhalb der Linie und der bilanzpolitischen Entscheidungen, die du gemeinsam mit dem Mandanten triffst. Steuerung und Beratung des Unternehmers Führe das Monats- oder Quartalsgespräch mit dem Unternehmer und übersetze die Zahlen in eine Handlungslinie. Dein Maßstab: Er kann danach eine Entscheidung treffen, nicht nur eine Zahl wiederholen. Baue Planung und Steuerung auf dem laufenden Rechnungswesen auf — Ergebnis-, Bilanz- und Liquiditätsplanung mit Szenarien, Forecast, Soll-Ist-Abgleich, Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung, Deckungsbeitrag. Begleite Finanzierungen und Bankgespräche, bereite ratingfähig auf und zeig die Liquiditätsreserven, die im Working Capital und im Forderungsmanagement liegen — die häufigste ungenutzte Quelle im Mittelstand. Schneide diese Leistungen so zu, dass sie wiederkehrend tragen und mit dem Mandatsvolumen skalieren, statt bei jedem Mandat neu erfunden zu werden. Team-Führung und Standard Führe dein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch — Review, Eskalations-Entscheidungen, Performance-Gespräche, Mitwirkung im Hiring. Entwickle die Erfahrungsstufen innerhalb der Linie weiter: Wer welchen Abschluss baut und wer welches Steuerungsgespräch führt, ist eine Frage von Befähigung und Anspruch, nicht von Dienstalter. Setz den Ton im Team: hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation, autonom in der Ausführung. Leistung wird bei uns gefeiert, nicht versteckt — wer gut ist, findet hier

Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, Next.js / Node.js) to join our Engineering team in Munich.  At Atolls, your role will play a key role in helping us provide a seamless web experience that enables users to find the Smart Shopping capability that best matches their intent through search, navigation, and a personalized home page, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys. Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Take ownership of solution architecture, improving performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency. Drive feature development from inception to delivery, contributing to an ambitious product roadmap. Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies. Foster an open communication culture, encouraging feedback and supporting conflict resolution.   Your Profile: 6+ years of experience in software development. Proficiency in Next.js / Node.js , with experience building reusable libraries using an atomic design system. Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and concurrent event-based systems. Advanced knowledge of TypeScript , including its environment and type system. Extensive expertise in GraphQL . Keen architectural mindset with an eye for application design patterns . Excellent communication skills with fluency in English (written and spoken). Desirable Skills: Working knowledge of Apollo GraphQL . Experience with PHP Symfony . Experience working with AWS cloud . Basic understanding of SQL databases and schema-less concepts. Knowledge of E2E testing (e.g., WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar tools). jobs.title: Product Engineer — Working Student
jobs.description: <p><strong>Working Student - Product Engineer</strong></p> <p>Over 4 million merchants use our card readers to process payments in 34 countries. As we build a world where every business can thrive, we continually expand our range of products and services. We are a truly global fintech company, with 3,000+ people from 93 nationalities spread across 22 offices on four continents.</p> <p>As the People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience. As our Product Engineer - Working Student, your first mission will be to help us rethink Feedback and Team Reviews: learn how the process works today, find the friction and turn promising ideas into product experiences that colleagues can test.</p> <p>The work starts frontend-first: build realistic prototypes in React, Next.js or similar and explore a simpler product layer over Workday, our system of record. If a direction proves valuable, you may help grow it into a standalone internal app - from interface and APIs to data models, authentication and integrations - alongside People Tech and engineering partners.</p> <p>This is a real product challenge, not a side quest: you will learn across discovery, UX, frontend, testing and product decisions, supported by mentorship and code review. You will collaborate with Product Owners, process owners, people tech and workday specialists, sumuppers, managers, people partners, people analytics and senior stakeholders, with potential exposure to backend development, integrations and production delivery. If your favourite way to answer “what if?” is to build it, you will fit right in.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Find the right problem: </strong>Speak with process owners, employees and managers to understand Feedback and Team Reviews, identify friction and decide what is worth solving first.</li> <li><strong>Shape a focused product slice: </strong>Turn requirements, questions and constraints into clear user journeys and an MVP that can teach us something useful.</li> <li><strong>Prototype and iterate quickly: </strong>Build realistic frontend experiences in React, Next.js or similar; compare directions, test assumptions and adjust when the evidence points somewhere better.</li> <li><strong>Design for different kinds of work:&nbsp; </strong>Create accessible, intuitive flows for office-based teams, metrics-driven Field Sales colleagues and on-site teams without building three separate products.</li> <li><strong>Think end to end:&nbsp; </strong>If the concept is validated, help evolve it towards a standalone app while considering APIs, data, authentication, privacy, deployment, integrations and what should remain in Workday.</li> <li><strong>Use AI as a co-pilot, not an alibi:&nbsp; </strong>Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Lovable or similar to accelerate development while still understanding, checking and owning the result.</li> <li><strong>Make the learning visible: </strong>Demo your work, explain decisions and trade-offs, respond to feedback and document the findings and technical choices that should shape the next version.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You’ll be great for this role if</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Student status. </strong>You are currently enrolled at a university and available for a part-time role based in Berlin.</li> <li><strong>Modern web development skills. </strong>You have built web applications with React, Next.js or a similar frontend framework. Coursework, internships, hackathons, personal projects and portfolio work

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description: 🌍 About Outpost Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it. Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself. Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise. 🧠 The Role We're hiring a second Executive Assistant to support our CEO. We already have an EA, and she isn't going anywhere. You'll report to the CEO and work alongside her: she keeps inbound, customer routing and the investor-facing side, takes diary, travel, logistics, internal admin, and hiring coordination. You'll join to take a defined set of workstreams off that plate. Roughly 70% of this role is executive support. The other 30% is hiring - and that's where the leverage is. We run a five-stage interview loop across engineering, ops, product, GTM and tax, hiring around two people a month. Someone needs to own the machinery: scheduling across five calendars and four countries, keeping candidates warm, chasing feedback, making sure nobody good goes cold because a diary didn't line up. This is a role for someone early in their career who is unusually organised and wants to learn how a company actually gets built. You won't be handed a finished process. jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the Founders
jobs.description: We are hiring an Executive Assistant to the Founders to own the calendars, correspondence, travel, and follow-through of our two co-founders. Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast. The role The two co-founders carry the work that decides this company: product, clients, the investor network, the brand. Their time is the scarcest resource in the business, and protecting it will be your mandate. You manage both calendars across time zones, own both inboxes, plan and oversee travel, prepare the founders for the meetings that matter, and ensure every commitment they make is kept. This is a position of ownership, not a list of tasks. You exercise judgment, act independently, and involve the founders only when a decision genuinely requires them. You work AI-first, like the rest of the company: tooling carries the mechanical work, and your time goes to judgment, anticipation, and trust. You report directly to both co-founders and hold one of the most trusted positions in the company. What you will own Both calendars across time zones: scheduling, conflicts resolved before they surface, preparation time protected, and our Monday and Thursday meeting rhythm maintained. Both inboxes: triaged daily, replies drafted in each founder's voice, nothing important left waiting. Travel end to end: planned, booked, briefed, and resolved in real time when plans change. Meeting preparation and follow-through: the right briefing beforehand, actions captured and pursued afterward. The commitment layer: what the founders have promised, to whom, by when, tracked to completion. The systems behind it all, built on the best AI tooling, so mechanical work never requires attention twice. You are a fit if you Have supported a founder or C-level executive at a fast-moving company, and can describe what never required their attention because of you. Have managed calendars across three or more time zones and understand the craft: buffers, batching, protected working time, and declining requests on someone else's behalf with grace. Write well enough to draft in another person's voice, and judge well enough to know what can be sent without asking. Have owned travel end to end, including disruptions resolved before the principal ever felt them. Can support two principals at once: competing priorities held, both agendas moving, neither founder resolving minor conflicts. Treat discretion as a reflex: names, transactions, and conversations remain confidential, always. Build systems rather than task lists: standing rhythms, documented processes, and automation that outlasts your busiest week. Operate with modern tooling: AI runs your scheduling, briefings, and follow-ups, so your time goes to judgment rather than administration. What we offer Fully remote. This position operates in real time across the founders' working day rather than asynchronously. Meetings across the company batch on Mondays and Thursdays, and you are the one who maintains that rhythm. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct trust from both co-founders, full visibility into the company, and a position that grows as the company does. How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application. Please do not include the names of former principals or any of their confidential matters; we evaluate how you work, not who you have worked for. jobs.title: Junior Space Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Junior Space Systems Engineer Location: London, UK (on-site, Borough / London Bridge) Type: Full-time Level: Junior / early-career - ideal for someone coming off a graduate scheme, though exceptional recent graduates with strong project experience are very welcome Compensation: £35,000–£45,000 depending on experience, plus meaningful equity through our government-backed EMI scheme _____ We are Foundational We're an early-stage, mission-driven startup tackling one of the hardest and most exciting engineering challenges in the space domain: building the most precise understanding of space and Earth using ground-based lasers. Using satellite laser ranging (SLR) and space debris laser ranging (SDLR) data, we're giving the next generation of space companies exquisite orbital data - the foundation for resilient navigation, Earth observation, and precise space traffic control. This is essential infrastructure for the sustainability and resilience of the space domain, and we think it will be foundational to the future economy. Our network doesn't stop at the ground. To close the loop on precision, we're building the small optical payloads that fly on-orbit and talk back to our stations, and the systems engineering that ties ground, space, and data platform into one coherent whole. That's where you come in. The role This is a hands-on engineering role where the successful candidate will be as happy working in the lab as they are behind a computer. You'll work in our space team but may get involved in ground systems as well - helping to define what we build, model it, then get hands-on to build, test, and prove it. You'll see the full lifecycle: early concept and trade studies, through modelling and design, into integration, environmental test, and validation against our ground network. It's physics-first, hands-on work with a quick path from your bench to orbit. You'll sit in a small team of software and hardware engineers who don't draw hard lines between disciplines, and you'll be expected to cross those lines too. Specifically, you'll get stuck into: Systems engineering. Turning mission needs into requirements, interfaces, and budgets (mass, power, link, pointing, timing, error). Running trade studies and making the case for a design decision with numbers behind it. Modelling & analysis. Building performance models - radiometry and link budgets, atmospheric transmission, pointing and attitude, detection probability - and using them to drive real design choices rather than to decorate them. Design & build. Contributing to the design of small space-based payloads and ground subsystems: component selection, layout, tolerancing, and assembly of hardware and optical benches alongside our senior engineers. Integration, test & verification. Assembling and aligning hardware, then putting it through environmental qualification (thermal, vibration, vacuum) and performance characterisation - and learning first-hand what survives launch. Ground-to-space validation. Working with the ground systems team to validate ranging precision and pointing accuracy end-to-end, so the payload and the network behave as one system. Owning your corner. Documenting designs, feeding lessons into the next iteration, and taking real responsibility for a slice of the system as we grow. What we're looking for You don't need flight heritage or a decade of experience. We care far more about strong fundamentals, hunger, and the ability to learn fast in a hands-on environment. Essential A degree in space systems engineering, aerospace or mechanical or electrical engineering, physics, or a closely related field. Strong engineering and physics fundamentals, and the instinct to reach for a first-principles estimate before an opinion. Some practical engineering experience - a graduate scheme, internship, placement year, or a serious university project or competition team. We are looking for a Senior IGA Consultant to turn access evidence into clear findings, practical access rules and delivery ready actions. The first likely assignment supports a financial services client reviewing who can see and change sensitive client information across Microsoft, data and business platforms. This is an associate contract. Work is assigned through paid work orders after client approval. The first assignment is expected to be a focused number of delivery days, with the possibility of later pilot, access review and recurring governance work. Tasks Working with the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant, you will: • Analyse user, group, role, permission and service account exports. • Reconcile technical access with the business reason for access. • Identify broad, stale, direct and conflicting access, and record the evidence for each point. • Carry out role mining and draft role and access matrices. • Test joiner, role change and leaver controls, including where old access is removed. • Draft clear findings that state the system, affected access, evidence, risk and required decision. • Support access reviews and certification so business owners can make informed decisions. • Review privileged accounts, service accounts and integration identities. • Support access testing for Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and connected business systems. • Maintain the findings register, evidence record and implementation backlog. • Support pilot testing and confirm that completed changes match the approved design. You will not be expected to act as the overall design authority. The Principal IAM Consultant owns the target access design and final technical challenge. Requirements Essential: • Strong recent experience delivering identity governance or access control work in a complex organisation. • Hands on experience analysing users, groups, roles, permissions and access grants. • Practical role mining and role based access control experience. • Experience designing or operating access reviews, certification and recertification. • Experience testing joiner, role change and leaver controls. • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory. • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint permissions. • Experience reviewing privileged accounts, service accounts or integration access. • Able to write short, evidence based findings in plain English. • Comfortable working independently from source records and recorded interviews. • Based in the United Kingdom and available during UK business hours. • Available for short, clearly scoped assignments that may grow after client approval. Strong advantage: • Experience in financial services, investment management or another regulated business. • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data platform. • Experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or another identity governance platform. • Experience of segregation of duties analysis. • Experience reviewing AI tools or connectors that can reach company information. • Relevant Microsoft identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CISSP, CISM or ISO 27001 certification. Please apply only if you have personally analysed access evidence and turned it into findings or role design. General project coordination or user administration alone is not enough. Benefits • Indicative rate of £425 to £500 per day, depending on the assignment and depth of relevant experience. • Fully remote work within the United Kingdom. • Clear work orders, agreed days and defined outputs before each assignment starts. • Direct access to the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant. • Focused work on real access problems in regulated organisations. • Potential follow on work across design, pilot delivery, access reviews and recurring governance. • Prompt payment against agreed timesheets

Checkly is the active reliability layer for developers and agents. We unify testing, synthetic monitoring, and observability into a single AI-native workflow, so engineering teams (and the agents shipping alongside them) can catch issues before customers do. Our platform is trusted by teams at Vercel, CrowdStrike, 1Password, Airbus, Mistral, ServiceNow, and Fastly. In 2024, we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV, and Accel to take things to the next level. That’s where you come in. As a part of our Sales team, you’ll play a key role in expanding our reach, building relationships with engineering teams, and showing them why Checkly is the best solution out there. We care about building a team where people of all backgrounds are encouraged to do their best work. To achieve this we built a flexible and async-first startup environment with inclusive benefits and full transparency about how we pay. What you’ll do We're looking for a Senior Sales Engineer to ensure our customers get the best out of Checkly. You will become an expert on Checkly and the Monitoring space, helping drive the Monitoring as Code revolution, and solve real customer problems. You will work with some of our most valuable customers in different stages across pre- and post-sales. You will assist prospects with the technical evaluation of Checkly, from first demo to the successful implementation of Checkly. You will own this process. You will speak with our customers directly and share your learnings with Product and Engineering, helping shape Checkly. As part of your role you will assist in continuously improving technical documentation, processes and policies. During your onboarding you will be involved in our Customer Support to learn our platform inside out and understand our customers. After that, you will chip in Support when needed from time to time. What you should have Strong technical skills that allow you to read, write and debug code (Javascript/Node.js preferred). 5+ years experience in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, a Customer Solutions or a Forward Deployed Engineer role. Experience working in dev-tools SaaS companies. Observability, monitoring, or testing background is preferred, but not required. Ability to use AI tools to accelerate customer-facing work: researching prospect environments, generating tailored demo code, building proof-of-concept repos etc. We build with Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools. Ability to be autonomous and self-motivated in a remote-first work environment, while you also enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping others. Exceptional empathy and curiosity. You love working with customers and take pride in seeing them succeed. Proactive and ownership-oriented mindset to help build long-lasting partnerships with Checkly’s customers. Excellent spoken and written English skills. Located in Europe, UTC+1 and UTC+2 time zones. Why us? Transparent salary (more info below) Become part of a fast-growing, and international team where your work matters. Your impact won’t get lost in layers of bureaucracy. Stock options 27 days of paid vacation Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave Annual company on-site Employment & contractor options Find out more here . What we pay Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location. For this role, there’s a 70% base salary - 30% commission split. The range is €115k-€140k OTE for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Portugal etc. €127k-€150k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc. Apply If this sounds interesting, please apply!

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Neko Health is a Swedish healthcare technology company co-founded in 2018 by Hjalmar Nilsonne and Daniel Ek. Neko's vision is to shift healthcare from reactive treatment toward preventative health and early detection. This requires completely reimagining the patient's experience and incorporating the latest advances in sensors and AI. Neko Health has developed a new medical scanning technology concept to make it possible to do broad and non-invasive health data collection that is convenient and affordable for the public. The company is based in Stockholm, offering the Neko Body Scan experience at locations in Stockholm, London and Manchester, with over 500 employees. About the Role A Data Scientist at Neko Health develops and implements data solutions that drive insights from sensor and healthcare data, enabling clinical decision support, and supporting innovations. This role partners with clinical researchers, engineers, and other teams to enhance products through data-driven insights. Responsibilities Data Modeling and Analysis: Develop algorithms, statistical models and machine learning models to address targeted challenges using sensor and healthcare data. Develop performance evaluation and implement performance monitoring of data products to ensure that the intended value is delivered. Data Management: Prepare, clean, and integrate datasets from various sources, ensuring data quality and accuracy. Collaborate with Data Engineers to build and maintain scalable data pipelines for efficient analysis. Support for Clinical Studies: Collaborate with clinical teams to define targeted clinical hypotheses, study variables and collection methods for clinical studies. Perform exploratory analyses and provide data insights to refine study designs. Research and Innovation: Stay up-to-date on data science advances to continuously improve model accuracy, efficiency, and clinical relevance. Develop proofs-of-concept of new medical devices and methods. Support patent development. Maintenance, scaling, and common tooling: Improve robustness of products, streamlining of processes and increasing efficiency of data science development by applying good software engineering practices. Requirements: MSc or PhD degree in a quantitative field for example Computer Science, Machine Learning or Physics. Expertise within data science, algorithm development, and statistics. Strong analytical abilities, collaborative mindset, and solid software engineering skills. A strong proficiency in designing and implementing machine learning algorithms. About the Engineering Team Distributed and Remote First We are nearly 100 full time engineers at the company, working from Berlin, Chamonix, Hamburg, Lisbon, Marseille, Vilnius, and Stockholm, spanning diverse disciplines such as Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Electrical Design, Algorithm Development, Machine Learning Development, Optronics Research, Frontend Development and more. We don't expect people to join us with a specific tech knowledge, but we do expect you to work with our tools. We use a mix of React, Typescript, C++, and Python. Our APIs are written in C# with ASP.NET Core, uses Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure Active Directory for authentication. Our headquarters and our hardware development team are in Stockholm, Sweden. We are a Remote First company; however, it is of course much easier to work remotely as a software engineer

jobs.description: Who is Heidi? Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that supports clinicians every step of the way, from documentation to delivery of care. We exist to double healthcare’s capacity while keeping care deeply human. In the last 18 months, Heidi has returned more than 18 million hours to clinicians and supported over 73 million patient visits. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi across 116 countries and over 110 languages. Founded by clinicians, Heidi brings together clinicians, engineers, designers, scientists, creatives, and mathematicians, working with a shared purpose: to strengthen the human connection at the heart of healthcare. Backed by nearly $100 million in total funding, Heidi is expanding across the USA, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with major health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, MaineGeneral, and Monash Health, among others. We move quickly where it matters and stay grounded in what’s proven, shaping healthcare’s next era. Ready for the challenge? The Role The New Bets squad builds Heidi's next products. Scribe already powers millions of patient visits a week, and Evidence and Remote are scaling behind it. Your job, alongside the New Bets PM and Team, is to build what comes next. This is zero-to-one engineering with a distribution advantage most early products never get. Your v1s don't launch into silence, instead they go in front of clinicians who already open Heidi every day, and who will tell you within a week whether you have built something they need. The squad is small on purpose. You'll build the whole thing: the React front end, the Python services behind it, and the prompts, retrieval and eval harnesses that make an LLM feature safe enough to put in front of a clinician. When a bet needs an onboarding flow, a data migration or a quick internal dashboard, that's you too. There's no one else to hand it to, so you will own the build from PoC through to production. Some of what you build will be killed. Ultimately, most bets don't survive contact with a real clinic, and the winners graduate into staffed product lines that inherit your code. For this to work, the code that dies has to have been fast to write, and the code that lives has to be worth inheriting. To fit in well with this team, you need to be the engineer who ships, ideally with: a few years of production software behind you, real judgment about what's good enough for a prototype versus what has to be right, and the appetite to own more surface area than any normal role would give you. If you're mid-level and impatient about it, this role is a fast-track to exposing yourself to complex problems and pushing towards a Senior level. jobs.title: BizOps Manager
jobs.description: About Foundation Health Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy. We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other. The Role Foundation Health is building AI-native pharmacy infrastructure, used by health systems, consumer health brands and pharma manufacturers. We're ~70 people, Series A, and growing quickly across the UK and US — and the operational engine behind the product needs to grow just as fast. That's where you come in. You'll be the right hand to our BizOps Director, working closely with our COO and with genuine visibility across senior leadership — the work you do here gets seen, used, and built on. You'll pick up the projects that don't fit neatly into any one team and run them from problem framing through to done, and you'll help shape the roadmap for what we take on next, not just deliver what's already on it. This is a generalist role in the truest sense. We're not looking for someone who's done one thing deeply — we're looking for someone who's done lots of things well, and can pick up whatever comes next. You'll also be working with AI at a depth most companies can't offer: it's the core of what we build and how we work, not something bolted on. And as we scale, this role scales with you — the scope is genuinely yours to grow. What You'll Be Doing No two weeks here look the same. Day to day could involve any of the below — and that variety is a big part of what makes the role interesting: Strategic projects — taking a loosely-framed problem, structuring it, doing the analysis, and driving it to implementation — while feeding into the roadmap for where we go next. Procurement & vendor management — sourcing, negotiating with, and managing the tools and vendors that keep the company running — from helpdesk platforms to AI tooling. Contracts & legal — supporting responses to RFIs, RFPs and bids from major US health systems, reviewing agreements, and getting comfortable in the commercial detail. Pricing — understanding what our solutions cost to deliver and modelling what we should sell them at. We’ve built a tiered, usage-based pricing structure from the cost-of-goods up — you’ll help evolve it as the product grows. Commercial & partnerships — supporting sales, client onboarding, and building the collateral and internal tools that help the commercial team move faster. Cross-functional work — partnering with sales, engineering, CX, product, and design to get things over the line. InfoSec & compliance — we operate in a HIPAA-regulated environment with a SOC 2 posture and an active certification programme. You’ll help run controls, policies and third-party risk assessments. You don’t need to be a security specialist, but you should bring a methodology and framework mindset. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Foundations team, the backend backbone that builds the reliable, scalable, fast systems everyone else at Encord builds on top of. The team's core challenges sit deep in distributed and data-intensive systems. The product mindset on this team is different from most of the company: short-term product insight matters less, long-term matters a lot. Foundations plans around how the next 6, 12, and 24 months will look, with an overarching shape to the problem: handling multiple orders of magnitude the data we handle today. Encord is growing rapidly, with our product as the key driver of that growth. A year ago, we were a team of 100; now, we're over 150 and continuing to accelerate. The systems that got us here won't get us to what's next. That's the problem you'll help solve. What you'll do Take end-to-end ownership of significant projects within our database and processing systems, from design and architectural decisions all the way to deployment, monitoring, and measuring impact Build robust distributed systems and reason carefully about how they fail and how they behave under load Contribute to performant protocols and APIs, such as our label-format API, that customers use directly Tackle complex domains and immense scale with simple solutions Raise the bar through code reviews, pairing, and helping engineers around you do their best work Who we're looking for You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed You want your work to have a tangible outcome for people. You're not satisfied with building products that do not see the light of day You are a builder. You enjoy all aspects of building not only software but a complete product, and are comfortable moving across the stack when necessary You enjoy problem-solving and thinking from first principles, reach for the simplest solution that works, and know when boring technology wins You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you Experience requirements 5+ years building large-scale backend infrastructure applications Deep fluency in at least one high-level language (we use Python and TypeScript, but we care more about depth than the specific language) Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and how they behave under load Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout, and monitoring Experience with data migrations or re-architecture projects is a plus Tech stack We are technology-agnostic at Encord and are not looking for experience across all of these. As long as you're open to learning, please apply. Backend: Python Frontend: TypeScript and React Deployment: Kubernetes Infrastructure: GCP Machine learning: PyTorch, CUDA, Ray Why Encord Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup Strong in-person culture: the team works from our London office 4+ days/week 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays Annual learning & development budget Trave

jobs.title: Werkstudent Mobile Development (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Bei uns entwickelst du nicht einfach nur blind nach Vorgabe, sondern gestaltest unsere Mobile App aktiv mit. Wenn du Lust hast, dich tief in Flutter einzuarbeiten, Dinge mutig zu hinterfragen und echten Impact zu liefern, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Deine Aufgaben Dein Bereich als Werkstudent im Mobile Development: Echter Code, echtes Produkt: Du unterstützt uns in unserer bestehenden Flutter-Codebase und hilfst bei der Entwicklung neuer Features. Blick über den Tellerrand: Du blickst über die reinen Anforderungen hinaus und hast bei der Entwicklung immer unsere Nutzer im Kopf. Von der Idee bis in den Store: Code schreiben ist nicht alles. Bei uns bekommst du Einblicke in unsere CI/CD-Pipelines und lernst, wie modernes Release-Management im Apple App Store und in der Google Play Console funktioniert. Architektur verstehen: Du lernst bei uns, wie man eine App-Architektur aufbaut und an neue Anforderungen anpasst. Wenn dir bestehende Strukturen unlogisch vorkommen, erwarten wir, dass du nachfragst. Problemlösung statt Copy-Paste: Du analysierst Bugs und Performance-Engpässe, verstehst die wahre Ursache und behebst sie nachhaltig. Dein Profil Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung mit Flutter und Dart gesammelt. Am allerwichtigsten ist uns dabei, dass du eigene Projekte (Hobby, Uni, Open Source, eigene App) vorweisen kannst. Füge deiner Bewerbung deshalb auf jeden Fall Arbeitsproben bei (ein Link reicht auch völlig). Mindset & Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest gern eigenverantwortlich und bewegst dich sicher in einem schnellen Umfeld, in dem Prioritäten manchmal drehen. Kritischer Geist: Du nutzt KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich als Sparringspartner – aber niemals als Autopilot. Du übernimmst generierten Code nicht blind, sondern verstehst, was er tut und hinterfragst die Lösungsansätze. Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst so, dass andere gerne mit dir arbeiten - remote, klar und verbindlich. Du bringst Deutschniveau mindestens auf dem Level C2 mit. Studium: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert (Informatik, Medieninformatik o. ä.) und hast idealerweise noch ein paar Semester vor dir. Tempo: Du hast die Fähigkeit dich schnell in neue Dinge einzuarbeiten. Wohnsitz: Du hast einen festen Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Warum wir? Deine Perspektiven: Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem jungen Team Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben, die viel Eigeninitiative erfordern Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche und transparente Kommunikation Zukunftsorientierte Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen Unsere Benefits: Zukunftssicherheit mit Extras Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und baue dir entspannt deine finanzielle Absicherung auf – wir unterstützen dich dabei mit einem monatlichen Zuschuss. Familienfreundlichkeit im Fokus Wir entlasten dich bei den Betreuungskosten durch einen monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung – damit Familie und Beruf gut zusammenpassen. Flexibilität durch digitale Benefits Ob Shopping, Tanken oder Freizeitaktivitäten – du erhältst ein monatliches Guthaben, das du ganz nach deinen Wünschen einsetzen kannst. Alternativ kannst du mit Wellpass deutschlandweit auf über 8.000 Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote zugreifen – online oder vor Ort – und profitierst dabei von unserem attraktiven Firmenrabatt. Fitness direkt im Haus (vor Ort in Ansbach) Kein Zeitverlust – nutze unser hauseigenes Gym , um dich vor, während oder nach der Arbeit fit zu halten. Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte Sichere dir exklusive Vergünstigungen auf unsere Marken – mit satten Rabatten auf Produkte von TEVEO, fayn. und Meek & Hon. Kostenloses Laden von E-Autos (vor Ort in Ansbach) An unserem Standort in Ansbach kannst du dein E-Fahrzeug bequem und kostenlos laden – nachhaltig und praktisch. Selbstverständlich ist für uns: Wasser, Kaffee und verschiedene Milchsorten in unseren Offices in Hamburg und Ansbach. Bewirb dich jetzt, wenn du dich in unserer Beschreibung wiedererkenns

We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo Build the best technology in-house , using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting We're looking for a Mid level PHP Engineer to join our growing UK Loans team, either based in or around London Our engineering organisation is home to over 200 talented engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and platform disciplines. You'll have the opportunity to work on everything from building and integrating new APIs to enhance the customer journey, to optimising our lending platforms, and engaging in deep architectural discussions. There's plenty to tackle, and we're excited to find the right people to take on the challenge. What we’re looking for Essential 3+ years experience with PHP Strong, business oriented, engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must) High degree of ownership and autonomy A good understanding of Symfony Experience with Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing would be a plus Strong automatic testing skills (unit, integration, functional, behat) Desirable Experience working on financial systems A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team Our Tech Stack We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development: Backend: PHP 8, Symfony 7, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes CI/CD: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (we deploy to production as soon as a feature is complete!) Testing: Behat, PHPUnit Interview process We value your time and have designed an efficient process to get to know you: A quick chat with one of our team to see if the role is a good match. Unsere Kombination aus Start-up-Dynamik, Handwerksstolz und echter Sinnhaftigkeit. Jetzt suchen wir dich als Founding Engineer - Fullstack (m/w/d) im Handwerk, um gemeinsam mit uns die nächsten Schritte zu gehen und nuuEnergy weiter aufzubauen. Deine Aufgaben Du bist Builder: Du baust täglich Code, der Baustellen profitabler und Handwerkern den Job leichter macht. Und du bist die Person, bei der technische Qualität zusammenläuft. Features end-to-end bauen. DB-Schema, API-Route, Frontend, vom Web-Cockpit bis in die Mobile Apps. Du lieferst das Ganze, nicht nur einen Layer. Die Reise vom Ticket zur Production ist bei uns kurz. Code-Reviews übernehmen. Ein großer Teil unseres Codes entsteht mit Claude Code. Architekturentscheidungen auf API-Ebene treffen. Wie schneiden wir Endpoints, wie designen wir Auth und Berechtigungen, wie strukturieren wir das Datenmodell für mehrere Hubs. Wie wir in unserem Stack bauen, entscheidest du maßgeblich. KI-Tools als Hebel nutzen. Claude Code und Cursor sind bei uns Alltag. Du weißt, wann sie dich schneller machen und wann du selbst ran musst. Mitdenken, bevor du baust. Wenn eine Spec technisch oder wirtschaftlich keinen Sinn ergibt, sagst du das, bevor du sie umsetzt. Es gibt keine eigene Dev-Abteilung, sondern ein kleines Team, das Konzept, Build und Betrieb gemeinsam verantwortet und entsprechend eng zusammenarbeitet. Was die Rolle nicht ist: K ein Product Management, keine Konzeptarbeit, kein Stakeholder-Management, keine Führungsverantwortung. Priorisierung und Produktentscheidungen liegen beim Product-Team. Du bist die Execution- und Qualitätsinstanz, nicht der nächste PM. jobs.description: Über Salonkee Wir bei Salonkee glauben, dass Friseure und Beauty- Expert:innen ihre Zeit mit Handwerk und Kreativität verbringen sollten - nicht mit Zettelwirtschaft. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen Europas bieten wir Salons eine Komplettlösung: von der smarten Online-Buchung bis hin zu automatisierten Zahlungen. Wir suchen keine Verwalter, sondern Gestalter. In Köln schlagen wir das nächste Kapitel auf und suchen jemanden, der unser lokales Team nicht nur führt, sondern gemeinsam mit uns wächst. Deine Rolle: Mitmacher, Stratege & Mentor Du bist das Gesicht von Salonkee in Köln. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ein schlagkräftiges Team aufzubauen und gleichzeitig sicherzustellen, dass wir nah am Kunden bleiben. Teamaufbau & Coaching: Du baust das Team auf ca. fünf Talente aus. Du führst keine Excel-Tabellen, sondern Menschen - durch 1:1s, gemeinsames Training und echtes Feedback. Präsenz im Markt: Du bist kein Büromensch. Du begleitest dein Team zu Terminen vor Ort, unterstützt bei der Kaltakquise und zeigst in Live-Demos, wie Salonkee den Alltag der Salonbesitzer erleichtert. Struktur schaffen: Du organisierst die Woche so, dass dein Team Erfolg haben kann. Du behältst die CRM-Pflege und die Kennzahlen im Blick, um frühzeitig zu sehen, wo wir nachjustieren können. Vorbildfunktion: Gerade am Anfang bist du selbst aktiv im Verkauf tätig. Nicht, um Rekorde zu brechen, sondern um den Markt in Köln im Detail zu verstehen. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung im Außendienst: Du hast 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb (idealerweise B2B) gesammelt und weißt, wie man Türen öffnet. Lust auf Führung: Du musst noch kein „Director“ gewesen sein, aber du hast das Talent, andere zu motivieren und Verantwortung für gemeinsame Ziele zu übernehmen. Startdatum: ab 07.09.2026 - Befristet bis 28.02.2027 Bei Klim arbeiten wir mit Landwirten und Lebensmittelunternehmen zusammen, um regenerative Landwirtschaft skalierbar und für Landwirte finanziell attraktiv zu gestalten. Über unsere Plattform unterstützen wir Landwirte dabei, die Bodengesundheit wiederherzustellen, die Artenvielfalt zu fördern und CO₂ zu binden – und gleichzeitig neue, verlässliche Einnahmequellen zu erschließen. Als Berliner AgriTech-Startup – unterstützt durch eine Series-A-Finanzierung in Höhe von 22 Millionen US-Dollar – arbeiten wir mit führenden globalen Lebensmittelunternehmen wie Nestlé und Kaufland zusammen. Gemeinsam reduzieren wir Emissionen in deren Lieferketten und stärken die langfristige Resilienz. Seit 2020 haben wir bereits 3.500 Landwirte unterstützt, die zusammen mehr als 900.000 Hektar bewirtschaften. Wenn du dich für ein nachhaltiges Ernährungssystem und echten Klimaschutz begeisterst, komm zu uns und hilf mit, einen gesünderen Planeten zu schaffen! Deine Mission Klim begleitet Landwirt:innen und Unternehmen bei der Umstellung auf regenerative Landwirtschaft. Klim hat eine digitale Plattform entwickelt, die den Betrieben eine einfache Möglichkeit bietet, ihre regenerativen Maßnahmen zu dokumentieren, Finanzierungen für ihre umgesetzten Maßnahmen zu erhalten und vom Fachwissen einer engagierten Community zu profitieren. Gemeinsam mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben und teilnehmenden Unternehmen setzt sich Klim mit dieser Arbeit dafür ein, den CO2-Ausstoß in der Landwirtschaft nachhaltig zu reduzieren, die Bodengesundheit zu verbessern und Artenvielfalt zu fördern. Um Qualität und Integrität der Arbeit sicherzustellen, hat Klim einen eigenen Monitoring, Reporting und Verifizierungsprozess (MRV) entwickelt. Als Teil unseres MRV (Monitoring, Reporting and Verification)-Teams stellst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren landwirtschaftlichen Partnerbetrieben die Qualität und Transparenz unserer Ergebnisse sicher. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest als Werkstudent:in in unserem Verifizierungsteam. Deine Aufgabe besteht in der Prüfung von Betriebsdaten hinsichtlich der umgesetzten Maßnahmen der Betriebe. Mit deinem agrarwissenschaftlichen Fachwissen prüfst du die Plausibilität von den eingesetzten regenerativen Maßnahmen, wie Fruchtfolgen, Düngemittelverwendung und Bodenbearbeitung. Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben zur Klärung von Fragen. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Deine Aufgaben Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance. Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre. CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen. Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern. Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden. Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks. Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich. FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung. Dein Skillset Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus. Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt. Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo Build the best technology in-house , using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting We're looking for an experienced, ambitious People Advisor to join our team. Reporting to our Senior People Partner, you'll own key aspects of the employee lifecycle, from probation and absence through to family leave and flexible working, pairing process execution with commercially minded advice, so our managers and employees are well supported. You'll also get exposure to our international populations as we scale beyond the UK. You'll balance hands-on advisory with exposure to strategic work happening across the People Partnering team (i.e. talent density, reward, leader development), leading high-impact initiatives. How you'll meet those objectives Employee Relations: Own probation and absence management, as well as supporting performance management. Provide practical advice to managers and employees, escalating more complex matters. Employee Lifecycle: Lead on aspects such as family leave and flexible working requests. Act as tier-2 support for anything beyond what our self-serve bot can resolve - and help us identify where that bot itself could go further. Wider initiatives: Support organisational change and the People agenda as we continue to scale, using AI and automation to deliver a faster, consistent experience for managers and employees. International Support: Support onboarding, policy and benefits for our US and MX populations as we scale internationally. Strategic Exposure: Proactively partner with the wider People Partnering team, seeking out hands-on exposure to strategic work. Insight & Optimisation: Spot patterns and feed them back into the team, flagging where policy, process, manager coaching, or systems could improve. What we're looking for Experience: 3-5 years experience in a HR advisory type role. Knowledge: Strong understanding of UK employment law and best practice (US is a plus) across the whole employee lifecycle, including experience in managing a range of ER cases. Advisory: Confidence engaging directly with managers and senior stakeholders - advising and challenging when needed. Commercial Awareness: Use good judgement to balance business and people needs. Autonomy: Self-driven and comfortable owning work independently, with the ability to plan and prioritise varied focuses. Technical Curiosity: Genuinely curious about AI and how it can be used to improve People processes — you look for ways that the team can work smarter. Ambition: Driven and hands-on, keen to build quickly in a high-growth environment. jobs.description: Job Description At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time. Key responsibilities: Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand. Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools. Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration). Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself. Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating. Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling. Your background: A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work. Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration. Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast. Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required. A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet. A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop. You’ll Thrive Here If You… You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human). You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners). You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners). You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple). KPIs & Success Measures Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings. Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet. Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support. Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews. Benefits: 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme Health insurance / private medical cover Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and developme

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3>ABOUT THE TEAM</h3> <p>The Maneuver Dominance team is building Thunder - an autonomous attack rotorcraft built to fight alongside crewed combat aviation to deliver overwhelming mass effects deep beyond the front lines. The team in London builds the Mission System and the Autonomy that makes aircraft like Thunder work.<br><br>A mission system is only a system if the parts agree. Thunder's payloads and subsystems are being developed in parallel, across teams and across companies, onto an air vehicle that is moving underneath them. The decomposition, the interfaces, and the evidence that it all works together are what hold that together. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age. Drive the maturity of our CI/CD pipelines, internal services and developer tooling, treating the platform as a product and our internal engineers and computational scientists as its customers. jobs.description: Field-Based Business Development Executive - Newcastle Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you. We’re looking for a Field Sales Executive to join our Newcastle team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with new restaurant partners across the region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth. Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be joining the Regional UK and Ireland team. The Regional UK and Ireland team drives Deliveroo's performance across all 4 nations of UKI. From Brighton, to Bognor to Belfast, we are experts in the local markets we serve, focusing on bringing the best possible selection to our customers and opportunities for growth to our partners. Execute strategic business development: Engage with independent restaurants via physical visits, emails, calls, and social platforms to demonstrate the commercial value of Deliveroo’s technology. Own the commercial onboarding journey: Oversee the end-to-end partner onboarding process to ensure it is fast, efficient, and seamless for new partners. Structure high-impact partnerships: Negotiate contract terms and partnership structures that secure win-win commercial outcomes for both restaurants and Deliveroo. Act as a local territory expert: Develop deep insight into the regional food scene, mapping out up-and-coming culinary trends and identifying the key brands that local customers crave. jobs.title: Head EMEA Refund Fraud, Integrity - Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description: About the Role The head of EMEA Refund Fraud will lead Doordash’s EMEA strategy for preventing and managing refund abuse across our marketplace. You will be accountable for the performance of the Credit and Refund (C&R) Fraud domain: setting the long-term vision, determining where we focus our resources, and building the team, controls and capabilities required to reduce fraud sustainably while protecting the experience of genuine customers. This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of Integrity, Customer Care, Product, Engineering, Analytics and Finance. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment. You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale. What You’ll Be Doing Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned. Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest. Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls. Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments. Owning Performance and Risk Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails. Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost. Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions. Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken. Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys. Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place. Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions. Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails. Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention. Challenge legacy processes and controls, simplifying or retiring them where they no longer provide sufficient value. Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment Act as the senior C&R Fraud partner to Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Merchant, Finance, Analytics and other Integrity teams. Translate fraud problems into clear product and business opportunities and influence roadmaps outside your direct reporting line. Lead complex decisions where fraud prevention, customer experience, commercial performance and operational efficiency are in tension. Create alignment around priorities, decision rights and accountability without relying on excessive consensus. Make longer-term trade-offs and ensure resources are concentrated on the initiatives with the greatest expected impact. Communicate complex risks and recommendations clearly to senior and executive stakeholders

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager - Payments Risk & Fraud
jobs.description: About the Role Every day, millions of customer transactions flow through our platform. Our challenge is to make payments effortless for genuine customers while preventing fraud, abuse, and financial loss. As the Senior Strategy & Operations Manager for Payments Risk & Fraud, you'll own one of our most commercially important problem spaces. You'll define the strategy for payment fraud, promotions abuse, cash risk, and chargebacks – balancing customer experience, growth, and profitability. This is an end-to-end ownership role. You'll identify opportunities, shape strategy, influence product and engineering roadmaps, partner with data science to improve detection models, and work closely with Finance and Payments to protect revenue while enabling sustainable growth. If you enjoy solving ambiguous, high-impact business problems using data, technology, and cross-functional leadership, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Own Defining our Payments Risk Strategy Own the strategy and roadmap for payment fraud, promotions abuse, cash risk, and disputes across multiple markets. Identify emerging risks, prioritise investments, and continuously evolve our controls to protect customers and the business while supporting growth. Driving Commercial Performance: Own the key business metrics that matter, including: Fraud losses Chargeback rates Payment approval rates Promotions efficiency Recovery rates False positive rates Evaluate trade-offs between risk, customer experience, and conversion to maximise long-term profitability Building Data-Driven Solutions Use data to understand fraud trends, uncover new opportunities, and measure impact. Partner closely with Data Science to improve fraud models, optimise decisioning, and reduce false positives. Develop executive reporting and dashboards that provide clear visibility into business performance and emerging risks. Leading Cross-Functional Execution Work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, Fraud Operations, Payments, and external partners to deliver strategic initiatives. Influence roadmaps, align stakeholders, and ensure our fraud capabilities continue to scale with the business. Represent Payments Risk across senior leadership discussions and drive alignment on priorities and investment decisions. Improve our Payments Ecosystem Partner with payment providers, acquirers, and card networks to improve payment performance, optimise dispute outcomes, and maintain compliance with scheme requirements. Continuously improve operational processes through automation, tooling, and scalable controls. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with strong analytical skills and enjoys solving complex business problems. You'll likely have experience in payments, fraud, fintech, marketplaces, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-driven environment. You'll bring: Experience owning complex fraud, payments, risk, or trust & safety initiatives with measurable commercial impact. Strong analytical skills, including SQL and data-driven problem solving. Experience developing business cases and influencing investment decisions.
